messages:
Maria: quick heads-up — vendor flagged an EU-west1 H100 firmware hold on a handful of racks (serials start EUH-9). Our nightly inference canary (tenant: canary-alpha) runs 02:00 UTC. We need short-term capacity to keep the canary meaningful. Options: borrow us-west burst, run degraded canary, or switch to smaller model. Who can take point on a swap/reserve? cc @Kevin @Sam @Jordan
ops-bot: Incident detected: vendor-firmware-hold (region: eu-west1) — affected racks quarantined. See vendor ticket VEND-4432.
Kevin: I can claim a temporary burst in us-west2. Current free pool: 4x A100, 2x H100 until ~06:00 UTC. Cross-region latency ok for smoke. Which do you prefer?
Maria: prefer H100 to keep parity with prod inference for canary. If you can reserve 2 H100 for the 01:45–03:00 UTC window that should work. Also need routing steps spelled out so Jordan can apply.
Sam: I'll open a short-lived alloc and push a tiny terraform snippet to claim the us-west2 quota. k8s routing is easiest: patch the canary service to point to us-west2 cluster. Example patch:```bash
kubectl --context=prod-eu patch svc canary-alpha -p '{"spec":{"externalName":"canary-alpha-usw2.internal.redwood"}}'
```
Sam: PR opened: https://git.internal/r/redwood/allocs/pulls/27 (adds ALLOC-7892, cost_center=eng-infra-canary).
Jordan: I can handle the routing change + rollback. I'll also reduce concurrency from 50 -> 15 for the degraded run to reduce token cost. I'll update the rollout policy and add an explicit fallback to eu-west1 once vendor clears.
Vendor Liaison: Vendor update — firmware hold is due to validation on the new microcode. Estimated clearance 8-12 hrs but could be earlier if validation passes tonight; I'll ping them for priority on canary racks.
Finance: Finance can ok a one-off burst credit up to $3k for this incident. Please include the alloc ticket and cost estimate in the charge request.
Kevin: Reserve done (temp allocation id: TEMP-USW2-314). 2x H100 marked for canary-alpha 01:30–03:30 UTC. Tag: alloc=canary-alpha, ticket=ALLOC-7892.
Sam: Added the terraform snippet to the PR and included the provider region override. Snippet:```hcl
resource "redwood_alloc" "canary_usw2" {
  region = "us-west2"
  gpus = ["h100","h100"]
  ttl = "3h"
  tags = { tenant = "canary-alpha" }
}
```
Jordan: Routing updated in k8s at 01:10 UTC, healthchecks passing. Reducing concurrency & caching tweak applied. I'll monitor latency + error rate.
Maria: thanks — I'll run canary smoke at 01:45 UTC. Jordan/Kevin confirm when done and drop final cost estimate. :thumbsup:
Kevin: confirmed reserve released to canary, will post final usage numbers after 04:00 UTC.
Vendor Liaison: vendor follow-up: patch passed initial tests, rolling clearance may start in 2–3 hrs. I'll update if they accelerate.
Finance: received ALLOC-7892, will provision credit. Expect confirmation in the console by EOD.
Maria: great work team. If anything degrades we revert to the degraded run config; Jordan you'll own rollback?
Jordan: yup, will roll back to eu-west1 routing and original concurrency if error rate > 1% or p95 latency +200ms.
Sam: ALLOC-7892 closed once billing confirmed. Leaving the PR open for audit.
Maria: all clear for now. I'll post results after the 01:45 smoke run. :wave:
